page_title: GEN 2-2 NAP | Genoa v Napoli 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Alessio Zerbin (Napoli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Aaron Martin makes way for Johan Vasquez (Genoa).
89' Here is a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going off and Rudi Garcia gives the last tactical orders to Alessio Zerbin (Napoli).
87' A pass by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
84' 2 - 2 Goal! Matteo Politano (Napoli) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the top right corner. 2:2.
83' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Napoli as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
82' There's a break in play and referee Michael Fabbri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Napoli using VAR. This could be interesting!
82' Surely that's handball by one of the Genoa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
78' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kevin Strootman will be replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Jens Cajuste tees up Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top left corner. 2:1.
75' Milan Badelj (Genoa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
75' Rudi Garcia decides to make a substitution. Stanislav Lobotka will be replaced by Jens Cajuste (Napoli).
74' The substitution is prepared. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Stefano Sabelli.
72' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Josep Martinez easily deals with the threat.
71' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
71' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Now Napoli have a corner.
69' Matteo Politano (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
65' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
63' Handball by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa).
61' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
58' Rudi Garcia has decided to make a change. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replaces Mario Rui.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Frank Anguissa cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' Corner kick. Genoa will have an opportunity.
56' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Kevin Strootman laid the ball off to Mateo Retegui (Genoa), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
55' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
53' The linesman makes the right call and Genoa will have a corner.
48' Mario Rui (Napoli) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
46' Rudi Garcia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Politano (Napoli) replacing Eljif Elmas.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) meets a cross inside the box, but Josep Martinez wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Referee Michael Fabbri points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Mattia Bani (Genoa) goes wild in celebration.
40' Wait! Referee Michael Fabbri has indicated he is going to review the Genoa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Nice headed pass by Koni De Winter to Mattia Bani (Genoa), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 1:0.
39' The ball goes behind for a corner. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
34' Napoli are awarded the free kick.
33' The referee is firm and issues Mateo Retegui (Genoa) a deserved yellow card.
33' Mario Rui (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Josep Martinez, who smothers the ball.
32' Napoli have a free kick.
32' Koni De Winter (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
29' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
25' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' A player from Genoa commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
19' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) meets a cross inside the box, but Josep Martinez wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
15' Aaron Martin (Genoa) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
12' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
6' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) latches onto a short pass from Stefano Sabelli inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.
4' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

Napoli will kick the game off.
